section_summary.extract_value: This section is an overview of positive body image research, emphasizing a shift from pathology-focused approaches to a holistic account that includes body appreciation and other facets of positive body image. It highlights that most empirical work has focused on body appreciation and hedonic well-being, notes the need to examine multiple facets of well-being (emotional, psychological, social), and calls for broader investigation of associations between positive body image and eudaimonic indicators of functioning.
section_summary.evidence_source: "Over the past decade, scholars have turned their attention to the construct of positive body image, signalling an important shift in the field from a focus on pathology to a more holistic and comprehensive account of the body image concept (for reviews, see Tylka, 2011, 2012; Tylka & Wood-Barcalow, 2015a)."; "In terms of mental health specifically, there is now a wealth of evidence indicating that positive body image is directly associated with improved outcomes."
